_readme: Optional film roll info, shown quietly in the lightbox and album headers. Keys are 'catalogSlug', 'catalogSlug/albumSlug' or a photo id; more specific keys override less specific ones. All fields are optional: film, camera, lens, iso, lab, notes. Keys starting with '_' are ignored. See README.md ('Film roll info').

_example-catalog/example-album.notes: Example entry (ignored because of the underscore). Copy it, rename the key to a real slug, and fill what you know.
